# ConsentLayer

> ConsentLayer is an automated DPDP Act (Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023) compliance platform engineered for Indian SME healthcare providers, clinics, and pathology labs.

## Core Documentation & Statutory Guides

- [Healthcare DPDP Compliance Master Guide](https://consentlayers.in/blog/dpdp-act-healthcare-compliance-guide): Complete operational guide for diagnostic labs and clinics covering Data Fiduciary obligations and Section 33 liability calculations.
- [DPDP Section 5 Notice Compliance](https://consentlayers.in/blog/dpdp-section-5-notice-pathology): Technical requirements for multilingual, unbundled Section 5 consent notices for pathology centers.
- [WhatsApp Medical Report Risks](https://consentlayers.in/blog/whatsapp-medical-reports-dpdp-compliance): Security breakdown and Section 8 safeguard protocols for patient PDF report dispatch.
- [DPDP Compliance Library](https://consentlayers.in/blog): Central index and catalog of healthcare data protection guides.

## Platform Access

- [Clinic Login & Audit Engine](https://consentlayers.in/login): Access portal for running automated privacy scans and compliance audits.
- [Compliance Support](https://consentlayers.in/support): Public compliance inquiry and account recovery assistance.
